app.title: Zhejiang Water Resources Annual Report Query & Export
app.summary: A person picks one report category, then the years and cities they want from a built-in collection of annual report tables, and runs the query. The tool finds every matching file, stacks them into one table with year and city columns, sorts it, and shows it with a row count, or a warning if nothing matches. The person then downloads the combined table as a CSV or an Excel file named after the report category.

task.text: Pull one category of annual statistics for chosen years and administrative areas out of a set of per-year, per-area report tables, and save it as a single spreadsheet.

data.text: Annual report tables of water supply, water use and socio-economic indicators, stored as one CSV per year, city and report category, with one row per county or district and numeric indicator columns
data.item: one county's row of indicators in one year's report table for one city

stage.text: pulling report tables together into one dataset, before analysis

mechanism.text: A sidebar form sets the query: one report category, several years and several cities, all selected by default. Running it merges the matching files into one table shown in the main area, with download buttons for CSV and Excel underneath.

field.text: regional water resources statistics in hydrology and water management

workflow.name: query a collection of report tables and export the combined subset

steps.here: Report tables ship with the tool as CSVs named year_city_category. The year, city and category options are read from the file names, and the city list is limited to the official prefecture-level cities.

steps.step: filter to the items that matter
steps.here: Choose one report category from a dropdown, then years and cities from multi-selects (all selected by default), and press 查询 (Query)

steps.step: combine the matching pieces into one table
steps.here: Every file matching a chosen year × city for the category is read and stacked, with year and city columns added. Rows are sorted by year, city and county, and the result is kept in the session.

steps.step: look over every item at a glance
steps.here: The combined table is shown full width under a heading with the category name and row count, or a warning to adjust the filters if nothing matched
Download the table as a UTF-8-with-BOM CSV or as an Excel workbook, each named after the report category

distinctive: The data is split into one file per year, city and report category, and the files are joined on demand, with year and city columns added so the stacked rows stay identifiable
Only a fixed list of the province's official prefecture-level cities is offered. Sub-totals and regional aggregates in the files are left out.
Only one report category can be queried at a time, because the categories have different columns
The CSV export is written with a byte-order mark so spreadsheet software reads the non-Latin column headers correctly
No upload is needed: the dataset is built in, and the last query result stays in the session, so downloading does not clear it

parts.title: Merge matching files
